verdict.rationale: Sierra documents step-by-step workflows (journeys) that can be authored from scratch or generated from existing SOPs, transcripts, or expert interviews, plus 'sophisticated logic' in the Agent SDK. That supports structured multi-step resolution rather than a single canned reply. Its τ-bench research frames agents as handling dynamic, multi-turn conversations, but none of the evidence explicitly shows the agent asking clarifying questions or adapting troubleshooting to customer answers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of clarifying-question behavior, examples of branching multi-step troubleshooting in live conversations, independent or hands-on corroboration of resolution quality.
